items.title: 6.9.3 Solution ki enthalpy tabdeeli ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.9.3, printed pages 133-134.

blocks.text: Solution ki, ya hydration ki, enthalpy tabdeeli enthalpy cycle bana kar aur Hess ka qanoon istemal kar ke nikali ja sakti hai. Gaseous ions ionic solid banate hain (lattice energy) aur ionic solid halta hai (enthalpy of solution); gaseous ions seedhe aqueous solution ke ions mein bhi jate hain (cation aur anion ki enthalpy of hydration). Cycle se, delta Hlatt + delta Hsol = delta Hhyd.

blocks.alt: Teen halke neele dabbon ka energy tikon: 'gaseous ions' (oopar baen), 'ionic solid' (oopar daen) aur 'ions in aqueous solution' (neeche). Gaseous ions se ionic solid: lattice energy, delta H(o)latt. Gaseous ions se aqueous solution ke ions: cation aur anion ki enthalpy change of hydration, delta H(o)hyd. Ionic solid se aqueous solution ke ions: enthalpy change of solution, delta H(o)sol. Surkh dashed teer bil-wasta (indirect) raste ke gird ghoomta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.7: Hess ke qanoon se ionic solid ke aqueous solution banne ka energy cycle (kitab ki Figure 6.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.7 mein daen teer (ionic solid se aqueous ions) ke neeche ghalti se 'delta H(o)hyd' chhapa hai, halanke us ke saath likha hai 'enthalpy change of solution'. Durust label delta H(o)sol hai. Do raste ek hi jagah pohanchte hain, is liye delta H(o)latt + delta H(o)sol = delta H(o)hyd.

blocks.alt: Sodium fluoride ka enthalpy cycle: Na+(g) + F-(g) se NaF(s), delta H(o)latt = -902 kJ mol-1; Na+(g) + F-(g) se Na+(aq) + F-(aq) (+aq), delta H(o)hyd [Na+] = -406 aur delta H(o)hyd [F-] = -506 kJ mol-1; NaF(s) se Na+(aq) + F-(aq), delta H(o)sol. Surkh dashed teer bil-wasta rasta dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Sodium fluoride ka enthalpy cycle (Sample Problem 6.8, Step 1) (kitab ke safha 134 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: NaCl ke liye lattice energy -787 kJ fi mol aur Na+ aur Cl- ki hydration enthalpies -406 aur -364 kJ fi mol hain. Delta Hsol nikalein aur Table 6.2 se muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Delta Hsol = delta Hhyd - delta Hlatt = (-406 - 364) - (-787) = -770 + 787 = in adaad se +17 kJ fi mol, table ke 4.98 kJ fi mol ki tarah endothermic; theek qeemat istemal shuda data par munhasir hai, magar nishan mutabiq hai: lattice energy hydration energy se thori zyada hai.

items: Energy cycle: delta Hlatt + delta Hsol = delta Hhyd, to delta Hsol = delta Hhyd - delta Hlatt; NaF: (-406 - 506) - (-902) = -10 kJ fi mol.
